honesty_notes: Every PASS definition below is a contract for a FUTURE console run; nothing in this spec claims any rung is currently PASSED.

Which log path the composed runtime routes Lua print() into is a property of the runtime build, not of the mod — the rung-4 oracle is deliberately path-agnostic (grep the ACTIVE Lua log for the mod tag).
The FC-1 runtime checks (FC1-A..D) are specified, materialized offline, and host-tested on synthetic bytes only; runtime verdicts remain UNCLAIMED until the probe runs in-game under its own build_id.
The pad provider is hardware_runtime_validated:false; the first real-pad read happens at rung 5's first console attempt and ScePad failures are expected findings, not fakes.

The query-harness S2 gate has no production publisher wired yet (SEAM S2 GAP): until PublishStagedNativeLayoutMaps succeeds, every on-target dispatch is CORRECTLY refused with RefusedLayoutGateClosed — that refusal is honest negative evidence for rung 2, not a harness bug.
